core_job: Keep one private, on-device record of your periods and life-stage events (cycle, trying to conceive, pregnancy, menopause) and see what it says: your real measured cycle lengths, the next period as a range rather than one day, the fertile window, pregnancy weeks and days since your last period. It is for women from their late 30s to early 50s whose cycles are changing and who will not put reproductive data on a server. Today predictions never learn from history (always lastPeriodDate + cycleLength, default 28, at user_profile.dart:83-87), logs cannot be back-dated (log_sheet has no date field) and only 90 days are loaded (app_provider.dart:174).
signature: Cycle Record, worked out on the device from the user's own logs. It measures completed cycles (median, last-6 range, bleeding days, a chart against the 21-35 day NHS band) and gives range predictions once 3 or more cycles exist. It also shows the STRAW+10 menopause-transition markers: a persistent cycle-length difference of 7 days or more recurring within 10 cycles, a gap of 60 days or more, and the date 12 months without a period would be reached. I fetched the source (PMC3340903, HTTP 200) and quoted it in the spec. Each marker is phrased as 'a pattern in your logs, not a diagnosis'. Finally, an appointment-report PDF (pure-Dart pdf 3.13.1, Apache-2.0) and a CSV export, shared through share_plus, with no network. Competitors were checked only through the keyless iTunes Search/Lookup API because web search was disabled. Flo (1038369065) describes a symptom 'Perimenopause Score' and data held by the company. Clue (657189652) is GDPR and subscription. drip (1584564949) is on-device but has no pregnancy or menopause stages. Balance (1503345959) has a health report but covers menopause only. All gaps rest on store descriptions only.
